text:
Title: Validate Card Fields on Submission

Description:
As a registered customer, I want to validate card fields (number, expiry date, and CVV) during the payment process, so that I can prevent failed payments from invalid card data and ensure a smooth checkout experience.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a customer enters a valid credit card number, expiry date, and CVV, When they click "Submit" on the Payment page, Then a confirmation message "Payment successful" is displayed within 2 seconds and the order status is updated to "Paid".
- Given a customer enters an invalid credit card number (e.g., 4111111111111111), When they click "Submit" on the Payment page, Then an error message "Invalid card number. Please check and try again" is displayed below the Card Number field and the Submit button is disabled.
- Given a customer attempts to make a payment after 3 failed attempts from the same IP address, When they click "Submit" on the Payment page, Then a banner reads "Payment attempts blocked for 30 minutes. Please try again later" and the Submit button is disabled for 30 minutes.

Title: Display Coupon Error Messages on Application

Description:
As a registered customer, I want to display clear error messages when applying a discount coupon during checkout, so that I can understand why the coupon is invalid or expired and make the necessary corrections.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a customer enters a valid discount coupon code, When they click "Apply Coupon" on the Checkout page, Then the discount amount is applied to the order total and the coupon code is displayed below the Coupon field.
- Given a customer enters an expired discount coupon code (e.g., EXPIREDCOUPON), When they click "Apply Coupon" on the Checkout page, Then an error message "Coupon has expired. Please try a different code" is displayed below the Coupon field and the Apply Coupon button is disabled.
- Given a customer enters an invalid discount coupon code (e.g., INVALIDCOUPON), When they click "Apply Coupon" on the Checkout page, Then an error message "Invalid coupon code. Please check and try again" is displayed below the Coupon field and the Apply Coupon button is disabled.

Title: Validate Card Fields on Submission

Description:
As a registered customer, I want to validate my card details (card number, expiry date, and CVV) during the checkout process, so that I can complete my order successfully without errors.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a customer has entered valid card details, When they click "Place Order" on the Checkout page, Then the order is processed successfully and a confirmation email is sent to the customer within 2 minutes.
- Given a customer has entered an invalid card number, When they click "Place Order" on the Checkout page, Then the error message "Invalid card number. Please check and try again" is displayed below the Card Number field.
- Given a customer has entered an expired card expiry date, When they click "Place Order" on the Checkout page, Then the error message "Card expiry date is invalid. Please check and try again" is displayed below the Expiry Date field.

Title: Prevent Multiple Failed Payment Attempts and Disable Order Placement

Description:
As a registered customer, I want to prevent further payment attempts after 3 failed attempts and disable order placement, so that I can avoid potential security risks and protect my account.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a customer has 3 or more failed payment attempts, When they attempt to place an order, Then the system displays the message "Payment attempts exceeded. Please contact customer support" and the Place Order button is disabled.
- Given a customer has 2 failed payment attempts, When they attempt to place an order, Then the system displays a warning message "Two failed payment attempts. Please review your card details and try again" and the Place Order button is enabled but with a warning icon.
- Given a customer has no failed payment attempts, When they attempt to place an order, Then the order is processed successfully and a confirmation email is sent to the customer within 2 minutes.

- Given a customer has no failed payment attempts, When they attempt to place an order, Then the order is processed successfully and a confirmation email is sent to the customer within 2 minutes.

Description:
As a registered customer, I want to ensure that my card details are validated correctly during the checkout process, so that I can complete the payment successfully and avoid failed transactions.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a valid card number, expiry date, and CVV, When I submit the payment form, Then the payment is processed successfully and a confirmation message is displayed within 2 seconds.
- Given an invalid card number, When I submit the payment form, Then an error message "Invalid card number. Please check and try again." is displayed below the card number field and the payment button is disabled.

Title: Display Clear Error Messages on Payment Failure

Description:
As a registered customer, I want to receive clear error messages when my payment fails, so that I can identify the issue and correct it to complete the payment successfully.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a failed payment due to insufficient funds, When I submit the payment form, Then an error message "Insufficient funds. Please check your account balance and try again." is displayed below the payment button and the payment button is disabled.
- Given a failed payment after 3 consecutive attempts, When I submit the payment form, Then a message "Payment blocked due to security reasons. Please contact customer support for assistance." is displayed below the payment button and the payment button is disabled.

Title: Temporarily Restrict Users with Repeated Failed Notification Attempts

Description:
As a system administrator, I want to temporarily restrict users with repeated failed notification attempts to prevent abuse, so that the system remains secure and reliable.

Acceptance Criteria:

• - Given a user has attempted to send notifications 3 times in a row with failed delivery attempts, When they attempt to update their notification preferences, Then the system displays the message "Your account has been temporarily restricted due to repeated failed notification attempts — please contact support to resolve" on the notification preferences page and disables the update button.

• - Given a user has had their account restricted due to repeated failed notification attempts, When they contact support and resolve the issue, Then the system removes the restriction and enables the update button on the notification preferences page.

• - Given a user has not attempted to send notifications in the past 30 days, When they attempt to update their notification preferences, Then the system does not restrict their account and allows them to update their preferences normally.

metadata.label: SCRUM-75
metadata.summary: Temporarily Restrict Users with Repeated Failed Notification Attempts

• - Given a user has entered an invalid email address (e.g., missing '@' symbol), When they attempt to update their notification preferences, Then the system displays the error message "Invalid email address: please check and try again" next to the email field.

• - Given a user has entered a valid email address but the delivery attempt fails due to network issues, When they attempt to update their notification preferences, Then the system displays the error message "Failed to send email: please try again later" on the notification preferences page.

text:
Title: As a user, I want to be able to update my profile details, including name and phone number, with validation for incorrect inputs, so that I can maintain accurate and up-to-date information.

Description:
**

* Update profile details (name and phone number)

* Validate for incorrect inputs (phone number format and mandatory fields)

* Upload or update profile picture

* Display error message for unsupported image formats or exceeding size limits

* Display confirmation message after successful profile update

* Temporarily restrict excessive profile updates for security reasons

* Ensure seamless user experience on mobile devices

**

Acceptance Criteria:

• **

• 1. The system allows users to update their name and phone number.

• 2. The system validates the phone number format to ensure it is correct.

• 3. The system checks for mandatory fields (name and phone number) to ensure they are filled in.

• 4. The system allows users to upload or update their profile picture.

• 5. The system displays an error message if the uploaded image format is not supported.

• 6. The system displays an error message if the uploaded image exceeds size limits.

• 7. The system displays a confirmation message after a successful profile update.

• 8. The system temporarily restricts excessive profile updates to prevent potential security risks.

• 9. The profile management feature works properly on mobile devices, providing a seamless user experience.

• 10. The system handles errors and exceptions gracefully, providing a user-friendly experience.

• **Assumptions and Dependencies:**

• * The system has a user authentication mechanism in place.

• * The system has a profile management database schema that stores user profile information.

• * The system has a file upload mechanism in place for uploading profile pictures.

• * The system has a security mechanism in place to prevent excessive profile updates.

• **Priority:** High

• **Estimated Effort:** 40 hours

• **Risks and Assumptions:**

• * The system's security mechanism may need to be adjusted to prevent excessive profile updates.

• * The system's file upload mechanism may need to be adjusted to handle different image formats and size limits.

• * The system's profile management database schema may need to be adjusted to store user profile information.

metadata.summary: As a user, I want to be able to update my profile details, including name and phone number, with validation for incorrect inputs, so that I can maintain accurate and up-to-date information.
metadata.label: SCRUM-63

text:
Title: Introduce One-Time Password (OTP) Authentication

Description:
As a customer, I want to see clear error messages when my email or password is invalid, so that I can understand what went wrong and try again. I also want to be able to log in using a One-Time Password (OTP), so that I can improve the security of my account.

Detailed Description:

The system should display clear error messages when the email or password is invalid. The user should be able to log in using either their password or OTP. The system should generate a One-Time Password (OTP) for the customer and allow them to enter it to log in.

Acceptance Criteria:

• Display Clear Error Messages for Invalid Login Credentials:

• - Given the email or password is invalid, When the user submits the login form, Then the system displays a clear error message indicating the invalid field (email or password).

• - Given the email is invalid, When the user submits the login form, Then the system displays a clear error message indicating the invalid email.

• - Given the password is invalid, When the user submits the login form, Then the system displays a clear error message indicating the invalid password.

• Introduce One-Time Password (OTP) Authentication:

• - Given the customer has a valid account, When the system generates a One-Time Password (OTP), Then the system stores the OTP securely.

• - Given the customer has a valid OTP, When the customer enters the OTP to log in, Then the system logs the customer in successfully.

• - Given the OTP is incorrect or expired, When the customer enters the OTP to log in, Then the system displays an error message indicating the incorrect or expired OTP.

metadata.summary: Introduce One-Time Password (OTP) Authentication
metadata.label: SCRUM-62

The system should check for valid card number, expiration date, and security code during checkout. If the card details are invalid, the system should display an error message indicating the specific issue. The system should also display a clear and concise error message if payment fails, including a clear call-to-action to correct the issue and retry the payment.

• Given the user clicks on a valid password reset link, When the user successfully resets their password, Then the system redirects the user to the login page.

• Given the user clicks on a valid password reset link, When the user fails to reset their password, Then the system displays an error message without redirecting the user.

Title: Provide OTP-Based Login for Added Security

Description:
As a user attempting to log in to the system, I want to see clear error messages when entering incorrect email or password and have the option to use OTP-based login for added security, so that I can quickly identify and correct my mistakes and feel more confident in the security of my account.

Detailed Description:

The system should display clear error messages for incorrect login credentials and provide an option to use OTP-based login for users who have enabled this feature. The OTP should be sent to the user's registered email or phone number and be valid for a limited time.

Acceptance Criteria:

• 1. Given the user enters an incorrect email, When the user submits the login form, Then the system displays a clear error message indicating the incorrect email.

• 2. Given the user enters an incorrect password, When the user submits the login form, Then the system displays a clear error message indicating the incorrect password.

• 3. Given the user has enabled OTP-based login, When the user submits the login form, Then the system sends a one-time password to the user's registered email or phone number.

text:
Title: Validate OTP and Prevent Brute-Force Attacks

Description:
** As a system, I want to validate OTP and prevent brute-force attacks by limiting OTP attempts and logging verification attempts.

**

Acceptance Criteria:

• **

• 1. Given a user initiates OTP login, When the system checks for OTP validity, Then it logs all OTP verification attempts (both success and failure) for audit purposes.

• 2. Given a user has 5 failed OTP attempts, When the system checks for OTP attempt limit, Then it displays a clear error message indicating that the OTP attempts have been blocked.

• 3. Given a user successfully logs in, When the system checks for OTP reuse, Then it redirects users to their dashboard after successful OTP verification.

metadata.label: SCRUM-52
metadata.summary: Validate OTP and Prevent Brute-Force Attacks

Title: Redesign OTP Login Flow for Better Security and User Experience

Acceptance Criteria:

• **

• 1. Given a user initiates OTP login, When the system checks for OTP validity, Then it displays a clear error message if the OTP is invalid or expired.

• 2. Given a user enters an OTP, When the system checks for OTP reuse, Then it prevents OTP reuse once it is successfully used.

• 3. Given a user has 5 failed OTP attempts, When the system checks for OTP attempt limit, Then it temporarily blocks further OTP attempts.

• **User Story 2: Improve OTP Validation and Security**

• **

Title: As a Developer, I want to input code to fix bugs in the development environment, so that I can impro

Description:
Description

Refined User Story:

Description: To enable efficient bug fixing and code improvement, the system should allow developers to input code to fix bugs in the development environment, validate the input code, and provide real-time feedback on the success or failure of the code input.

Acceptance Criteria

1. Input Code Validation: The system validates the input code for syntax and semantic correctness, and provides immediate feedback to the developer on any errors or issues.


2. Automated Testing: The system automatically tests the input code to ensure it fixes the bug and does not introduce new bugs or break existing functionality.


3. Real-time Feedback: The system provides real-time feedback to the developer on the success or failure of the code input, including any errors or issues encountered during testing.


4. Code Logging: The system logs the input code and the bug it fixes for future reference and auditing purposes.


5. Bug Tracking: The system allows developers to track and manage bugs in the development environment, including assigning, prioritizing, and resolving bugs.


6. Scalability: The system can handle a large volume of code inputs and complex code inputs without compromising performance or functionality.


Each acceptance criterion is specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound (SMART).


Each acceptance criterion is concise and easy to understand.


Each acceptance criterion is focused on a specific aspect of the system and does not overlap with other criteria.


Each acceptance criterion is testable and can be verified through automated testing or manual testing.



Assumptions

The system has a development environment where code can be input to fix bugs.


The system has a mechanism for tracking and managing bugs.


The system has a testing framework to validate the input code.


Non-Functional Requirements:


The system should be able to handle a large volume of code inputs.


The system should be able to handle complex code inputs.


The system should provide real-time feedback to the developer.


INVEST Principles:


Independent: Each acceptance criterion is independent of the others and can be tested separately.


Negotiable: The acceptance criteria are flexible and can be adjusted based on changing requirements or priorities.


Valuable: Each acceptance criterion adds value to the system and contributes to the overall goal of improving code quality and customer satisfaction.


Estimable: Each acceptance criterion is measurable and can be estimated in terms of time and resources required to implement.


Small: Each acceptance criterion is small and focused, making it easier to implement and test.


Testable: Each acceptance criterion is testable and can be verified through automated testing or manual testing.

text:
Title: Download Past Invoices as ZIP File

Description:
As a registered customer, I want to download past invoices as a single ZIP file, so that I can access all my past invoices quickly and easily without having to download each one separately.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a customer has logged in and navigated to the Invoices page, When they click the "Download ZIP" button, Then a ZIP file containing all past invoices is downloaded to their device within 30 seconds.
- Given a customer has no past invoices, When they click the "Download ZIP" button, Then a message reads "No past invoices found" and the Download button is disabled.
- Given a customer has a large number of past invoices (over 50), When they click the "Download ZIP" button, Then a progress bar is displayed and the ZIP file is downloaded in chunks to prevent browser crashes.

Title: Filter Invoices by Date Range

Description:
As a registered customer, I want to filter invoices by a specific date range, so that I can quickly find and download the invoices I need without having to manually search through all my past invoices.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a customer has logged in and navigated to the Invoices page, When they select a start and end date using the date picker, Then only invoices within the selected date range are displayed.
- Given a customer selects a date range that spans multiple years, When they click the "Apply Filter" button, Then the invoices are sorted by date in descending order.
- Given a customer attempts to select a date range that is invalid (e.g. start date is after end date), When they click the "Apply Filter" button, Then an error message reads "Invalid date range — please try again" and the filter form is highlighted in red.

Title: Generate Combined Invoice ZIP File

Description:
As a registered customer, I want to download all past invoices as a single ZIP file, so that I can easily access and manage my historical financial records without having to download each invoice separately.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a customer has an active account with at least one past invoice, When they navigate to the Invoices page and click the "Download ZIP" button, Then a ZIP file containing all past invoices is downloaded to their local machine within 30 seconds.
- Given a customer attempts to download a ZIP file with more than 50 invoices, When they click the "Download ZIP" button, Then a system message reads "Large invoice collection detected — ZIP file may take several minutes to generate" and the download begins in the background with progress updates displayed on the Invoices page.
- Given a customer has an outstanding balance greater than $100.00, When they attempt to download a ZIP file, Then a banner reads "Clear your outstanding balance to access historical invoices" and the Download ZIP button is disabled.

Title: Filter Invoices by Date Range in ZIP File

Description:
As a registered customer, I want to filter invoices by a specific date range when downloading all past invoices as a single ZIP file, so that I can easily access and manage my historical financial records within a specific timeframe.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a customer has an active account with past invoices spanning multiple years, When they navigate to the Invoices page, select a start and end date, and click the "Download ZIP" button, Then a ZIP file containing only invoices within the specified date range is downloaded to their local machine within 30 seconds.
- Given a customer attempts to download a ZIP file with a start date before the earliest available invoice and an end date after the latest available invoice, When they click the "Download ZIP" button, Then a system message reads "Invalid date range — please adjust start and end dates to match available invoices" and the Download ZIP button is disabled.
- Given a customer has no past invoices within the specified date range, When they navigate to the Invoices page and attempt to download a ZIP file, Then a message reads "No invoices found within the specified date range" and the Download ZIP button is disabled.

Title: Reset Password Via Email Link

Description:
As a registered user, I want to reset my password via a link sent to my email, so that I can regain access to my account securely.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a user clicks Forgot Password, When they enter a registered email, Then a reset link is sent within 2 minutes.
